description: Next published exchange holiday or half-day from the fixed MO static calendar list; weekends alone are not holiday events. No extrapolation beyond coverage. Official exchange notices take precedence.

exchange.description: Exchange code: SHFE, INE, DCE, CZCE, GFEX, CFFEX, SGE, SSE, SZSE, BSE, HKEX, NB, SB, TWSE, KRX, JPX, SGX, BMD, LME, ICE, COMEX, CBOT, CME, NYSE, NYMEX, EUREX or OSE; case-insensitive (shfe becomes SHFE), or an FC product slug such as shfe-cu (lowercased), at most 40 characters; required unless marked optional, with results limited to published coverage. This tool matches MO holiday market IDs directly; a product slug does not resolve to its exchange.
